requirements.description: GIVEN deliberately-bad and a versioned threshold WHEN evals:ci runs THEN it exits non-zero and reports the below-threshold score.
GIVEN known-good at or above baseline WHEN evals:ci runs THEN it exits zero with a passing verdict.
GIVEN a deterministic invariant failure WHEN evals:ci runs THEN it exits non-zero independently of judge score.
GIVEN invalid gate configuration WHEN evals:ci runs THEN it exits non-zero without a pass verdict.
GIVEN a completed gate run WHEN JSON output is requested THEN fixture, versions, score, threshold, verdict, and exit reason are present.
The CI command exits non-zero when the deliberately-bad score is below threshold.
The CI command exits zero when the known-good score is at or above baseline.
The CI command exits non-zero when the deterministic invariant scorer fails.
The CI command exits non-zero when the threshold configuration is invalid.
The CI JSON result contains the configured threshold when a gate run completes.
